diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~15% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (5 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.454), which favours a weighted combination.
